fields.description: The VM identifier in Atlas (the source of truth).
fields.label: Resource ID

fields.description: Human label, mirrored from the Atlas VM (resource_id is a UUID).
fields.label: Title

fields.description: The cluster (Atlas Instance / region) this VM lives in.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Frappe version the VM was provisioned with — requested at create, resolved to a bench image and echoed back by Atlas (an unbuilt version falls back to the default).
fields.label: Frappe Version

fields.description: Mirrors the Atlas Virtual Machine status verbatim.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Running
Paused
Stopped
Failed
Terminated

fields.description: The URL a bench VM is fronted at (https://<title>.<region domain>), reported by Atlas. The console deep-links into it and it backs the login URL. Empty for a non-bench VM.
fields.label: Gateway URL

fields.description: The one-click admin sign-in URL Atlas minted after the bench booted. Short-lived and single-use (see login_url_expires_at); Central regenerates it if the tenant clicks after it expires. Only set once the VM is Running; empty for a non-bench VM.
fields.label: Login URL

fields.description: When login_url stops working (Atlas's mint time + the token TTL). Central compares against this to decide 'use it' vs 'regenerate'.
fields.label: Login URL Expires At

fields.description: Set while Central is applying a hardware resize (stop→resize→start) to the real VM — the slow Firecracker operation runs in a background job. The console shows a "Resizing" state and blocks power actions while this is on; the job clears it on completion.
fields.label: Resize In Progress

fields.description: When the last reconcile (pull) refreshed this row.
fields.label: Last Synced At

fields.description: occurred_at of the last applied Atlas event. Used for last-writer-wins so a stale or duplicate push can't overwrite newer state.
fields.label: Last Event At
